description: Manifest of the cross-repository conformance corpus for euler-dataset-contract. Every path is relative to the directory holding this file. Enumerate the corpus from this manifest rather than by scanning directories, so that a consumer that cannot see a new fixture fails loudly instead of silently testing less.

covers_vocabulary.modality_key:unregistered: The head uses a modality.key with no registered meta fields.
covers_vocabulary.shared_meta:<field>: The head exercises this shared meta field.
covers_vocabulary.normalization:<rule>: Parsing rewrites the authored value; the canonical file records the result.
covers_vocabulary.section:<name>: The head populates this optional structural section.

valid_heads.name: rgb-minimal
valid_heads.head: heads/valid/rgb-minimal.json
valid_heads.description: The smallest valid head: required sections only, one registered modality, no addons.

valid_heads.name: rgb-file-types-camel-case
valid_heads.head: heads/valid/rgb-file-types-camel-case.json
valid_heads.description: A legacy producer writing fileTypes with mixed case, padding, and a leading dot. Parsing renames the field to file_types and normalizes each entry to a sorted lowercase extension.

valid_heads.name: depth-full
valid_heads.head: heads/valid/depth-full.json
valid_heads.description: Every depth meta field, both shared meta fields, dataset attributes, and two addon payloads.

valid_heads.name: segmentation-sky-class
valid_heads.head: heads/valid/segmentation-sky-class.json
valid_heads.description: The segmentation modality with a non-default skyclass value.

valid_heads.name: semantic-segmentation-shared-meta
valid_heads.head: heads/valid/semantic-segmentation-shared-meta.json
valid_heads.description: The semantic_segmentation modality carrying both shared meta fields and an addon.

valid_heads.name: custom-modality-open-meta
valid_heads.head: heads/valid/custom-modality-open-meta.json
valid_heads.description: An unregistered modality key with free-form meta. The ecosystem may add modalities before this package releases support for them.

valid_heads.name: custom-modality-without-meta
valid_heads.head: heads/valid/custom-modality-without-meta.json
valid_heads.description: An unregistered modality key with no meta at all. The canonical form omits modality.meta rather than emitting an empty object.

inventory.name: euler-loading-modality-types
inventory.description: Vendored copy of the modality vocabulary euler-loading emits, used to detect drift against the shipped modality inventory.
